title: February 16, 2016 Austin City Council Discussion
transcript:
AUSTIN CITY COUNCIL 
 
COUNCIL DISCUSSION 
TUESDAY, FEBRUARY 16, 2016 
7:00 PM 
THE ZACH THEATRE - 202 SOUTH LAMAR BOULEVARD 
AUSTIN, TX 78704  
 
State of the City Address 
 
7:00 PM 
 ATTEND THE 2016 STATE OF THE CITY ADDRESS 'GREAT CITIES DO 
BIG THINGS', HOSTED BY MAYOR STEVE ADLER. 
 
 
 
 
A quorum of Council members may be present. No action will be taken. 
 
The City of Austin is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. 
Reasonable modifications and equal access to communications will be provided upon request. 
For assistance, please call 512-974-2210 or TTY users route through 711.
